suno.estilo: Epic acoustic boss battle against a witch coven: grim, majestic, ritual intensity. Melancholic acoustic chamber folk for a dark fantasy game. Recorded live in a small stone chapel: natural medium reverb, warm close mics, organic human timing. Core ensemble: nylon-string guitar, lute, psaltery, low cello, wooden flute, small metal bells, singing bowls. Lead vocal: adult female mezzo-soprano, pure airy tone, light vibrato, invented language sung with Spanish and Latin vowels. Choir: small mixed chamber choir, soft and distant. Phase one: relentless guitar and lute ostinato, heavy low cello, war frame drums, anvil and iron bells, psaltery runs. Phase two: same tempo, the full choir chants, the lead voice soars, drums double. Strict steady 144 BPM with no accelerando, stays in E Phrygian throughout, 4/4. Form: 4-bar intro, 32-bar phase one, 4-bar drum-roll transition, 32-bar phase two, final hit.
